text:
Type: woven patterned cushion cover
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, traditional
Materials: textured woven jacquard fabric
Colors: dark navy blue, light beige, red, muted green
Shape: square, vertical stripes of stacked diamond motifs, red and green woven bands, nubby texture, knife edges, medium size
Feel: warm, earthy, cozy, handcrafted
Goes with: navy, rust and cream tones, leather, warm wood; bohemian, Southwestern or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mojave-Inspired Decorative Throw Pillow Cover, 20" x 20", Blue and Red
product.description: Bring a striking global touch to your room with a high-contrast pillow cover. Intricate details in the layered yarns give it a chunky, satisfying texture. 20"x20" Front: 43% Recyled Cotton, 28% Olefin, 14% Acrylic, 13% Polyester, 2% Cotton; Back: 55% Linen, 45% Rayon Insert not included Pillow cover features a zipper closure Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry.
